lastFeatureSummary: Offline maps: explored through Strategist + Planner + Architect (brief/PRD/architecture in pipeline/offline-maps/), then SHELVED by Dave as a distant roadmap item. Blocker is tile HOSTING, not rendering: offline rendering is solved (MapLibre + PMTiles + OPFS), but serving tile bytes requires us to host a ~100GB planet copy or regional extracts (Protomaps discourages hotlinking; OMT extracts need Planetiler) — an infra/cost commitment that conflicts with the serverless/self-hosted/free nature. No code or deps were added (research only). Recorded in DECISIONS.md. Revisit if tile-hosting appetite appears or the mobile apps prioritize field-offline.
